description: Turn an animated GIF or a photo into a moving pixel-dithered wallpaper behind New thread and your conversations. GIFs up to 8 MB play frame by frame at their own timing through the dither effect. Without an image, pick one of seven moving patterns; with a photo, one of five texture motions or Still, plus four dither styles. Save six backgrounds and switch with one click; images stay on your BB server. An optional GitHub activity overview needs the GitHub CLI signed in on the BB server. A fork of Aura by Mateo Cerquetella; install it instead of Aura, not beside it.
